implementation.targetScope: Native Fetch request preparation, fluent body readers, JSON, create/extend, hooks, retries, deadlines, cancellation and response-size limits. Root targets the used Ky2.2 contract; vky/legacy preserves the app's Ky1.8 URL, hook and HTTP error-body conventions. Progress callbacks, Standard Schema validation and forced-retry APIs are excluded.

changes: No upstream runtime ships; one independent request pipeline serves both entry points.
Cancellation remains effective during hooks, backoff, ignored-signal custom fetches and shortcut body reads.
Finite size limits count actual bytes; invalid configuration rejects before transport.
App migration explicitly selects the legacy entry rather than silently changing hook arguments or consuming error.response.

A single per-attempt cancellation scope spans transport and shortcut body reads; no unused total-timeout controller is allocated. Body timeouts now abort the transport as well as its stream reader, and every retry starts with a fresh scope.

caller.scope: Catalog/problem queries, signup validation, signed scoresheet errors, JSON mutations, mock worker request preparation and raw status inspection; no application adoption claimed.
